notes: Transmitter/receiver power levels are average power (footnote 3). Rx minimum input power, overload, and 25GbE optical performance are at 25.78 Gbps (25GbE) and BER 5x10^-5 using PRBS31 (footnote 4). Power budget 8–18 dB (footnote 4). FEC is required in host equipment for reliable operation; module optical parameters target BER 5x10^-5 for 25G Ethernet. Operating temperature -20°C to +85°C; module supports cold start at -40°C with max initialization time 90 s (footnote 5). Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C stated in table header column. Dispersion penalty max 2.5 dB stated without paired penalized parameter and operating condition. DDM: Yes.
